pages.title: The Seeds Work Now
pages.text: OreSpawn's crop seeds — $(item)corn$(), $(item)tomato$(), $(item)lettuce$(), $(item)radish$(), $(item)rice$(), $(item)quinoa$(), and $(item)strawberry$() — plant on farmland like any honest seed. Till, water, plant, wait.$(p)Harvested crops craft back into seeds, so one wild find seeds a whole field.

pages.title: Foraging Map
pages.text: No seeds yet? The wild supplies: $(item)wild corn$() and $(item)wild tomatoes$() dot the plains, $(item)wild strawberries$() hide in forests, and river and swamp banks grow the odd $(item)veggie patch$() of radish and lettuce.$(p)$(item)Rice$() and $(item)quinoa$() grow only in the Crystal Dimension — the same glittering place the $(l:orespawn_delight:the_butcher/tigers_eye_knife)Tiger's Eye$() comes from.
